SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-10-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-10-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. 506 PLAINTIFF STACEY LEE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SCOTT BRISCOE IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-10-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LEE, STAYCEE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BRISCOE, SCOTT $1,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $70.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,070.00, LANDLORD HAS NOT CARRIED HIS BURDEN OF PROVING HIS CLEANING CHARGES WERE REASONABLE IN LIGHT OF HIS 3/2/17 TEXT THAT "THE CLEAN UP WAS GREAT AND ALL IS WELL." THE COURT ALSO AWARDS $150.00 IN STATUTORY DAMAGES. SEE CIVIL CODE 1950.5 (L) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS RETURNED TO PLAINTIFF LEE, STAYCEE
